feature_definitions.cyto_absent: 1 if the cytotoxic state is truly absent; 0 if observed. Missing measurement is not absence.

upstream_measurement.normalization: Sum counts across gated cells, divide by the gated all-gene count library, multiply by 1e6, then log2(1+CPM); not mean single-cell log expression.
upstream_measurement.limitation: Requires compatible precomputed loads. This contract does not reannotate cells or normalize raw RNA.

target.output: Ridge probability from post-selection discovery fit; calibration/generalization not externally established

missing_policy.unavailable_molecular: Reject missing/nonfinite loads and absence flag; never invent biological zero

GSE290722_model.formula: expit(intercept_standardized + sum(beta_j * (x_j - mean_j) / scale_j)); use saved medians for permitted missing clinical values

solver.final_tuning: Three stratified folds, seed 20261023+99999, mean held-out log loss, ties toward smaller C

GSE290722_model.qualification: Post-selection fixed-panel discovery comparison; gene panel chosen after same-cohort v8 coefficient review. OOF metrics condition on this panel choice; bootstrap intervals condition on fitted scores. No external validation, validated decision threshold, or mechanistic contraction inference.

evaluation_receipt.status: Discovery-only OOF evaluation; not independent panel-selection validation
evaluation_receipt.metric_definition: Mean of ten repeat-specific pooled OOF AUROCs, not AUROC of averaged probabilities

bootstrap.unit: Patient, all ten repeat scores retained together
bootstrap.interval: Conditional percentile 95%, no model-selection or training-pipeline uncertainty

two_compartment_framework.comparison_limit: different gates, targets, cohort and fitted/fixed models; AUROCs not pooled

v12.compartment_mechanism: v11 did not prove predominant tumor-origin TCF7, strict T-cell restriction or Wnt causality

survival_limits.Gide_ON: blocked; unresolved endpoint origin and late biopsies
survival_limits.Gide_OS_new_scores: Schoenfeld PH test <.05; HRs are time-averaged summaries and may mislead
survival_limits.TCGA: diagnosis-origin prognosis, not ICI treatment benefit; endpoint/model sample sizes differ
survival_limits.RMST: unadjusted median split, supported horizon and support-conditioned patient bootstrap

gide_duration_sensitivity.ph_caveat: Schoenfeld rank-time test; nonrejection does not establish PH
